causal_thesis: A high-quality persistent impulse (IPS>=65) has greater economic continuation value when price subsequently confirms by breaking the original impulse extreme in the same direction.

signal.BUY_break_condition: first tick with Bid >= frozen impulse_high
signal.SELL_break_condition: first tick with Bid <= frozen impulse_low

execution.BUY_entry: Ask at first executable breakout tick
execution.SELL_entry: Bid at first executable breakout tick
execution.gap_rule: first actually executable tick; never fill at synthetic threshold

risk_exit.management: NONE; no BE, trailing, partials or time stop
risk_exit.day_end_exit: last executable tick of the same source day

cost_scenarios.central: recorded Bid/Ask only; no invented commission
cost_scenarios.note: R stresses are generic execution robustness penalties, not broker commission estimates.

decision.no_rescue: Do not alter score threshold, breakout window, stop, RR or management after seeing results. Any change creates a new descendant campaign.

next_if_pass: Freeze strategy implementation/hash, independent parity, then open a separately preregistered 2025 validation slice only.
next_if_fail: Reject this exact strategy identity; preserve IPS v2 and design a causally distinct descendant only.
